title: Exporting from KiCad
summary: Generating Gerbers, drill files, plot SVGs/PDFs, and raster copper images from a KiCad PCB project — for fab houses, laser isolation, or CNC milling.

title: Making PCBs with a Laser Engraver
summary: Workflow for producing single- and double-sided keyboard PCBs at home using a diode/CO₂ laser. Covers KiCad export, isolation toolpaths, copper preparation, alignment, and post-processing.

title: Flashing Firmware
summary: Compile and flash QMK, Vial, ZMK, or KMK firmware onto your controller. Includes bootloader entry, build environment setup, and per-firmware quirks.

title: Soldering Basics & Inspection
summary: ESD safety, solder joint quality, visual inspection for cold joints and bridges, and rework using flux and solder wick.

title: Troubleshooting Dead Keys & Halves
summary: Continuity testing, walking traces, diagnosing dead rows/columns, and fixing broken traces with jumper wires.
